narrative.overview: The page is a ledger of names you scan line by line once a week. Numbers come first and decoration hardly appears. Hairline rules separate the rows, tabular figures line up the columns, and change is marked in the margin with small coloured pills, not loud fills. Calm and sourced is the attitude: every figure carries its basis, and the design makes those bases look different so they're never blended.
keyCharacteristics: Dense, ruled and tabular: the page is the table.
Cool slate neutrals tinted toward the cobalt accent; no pure greys.
Semantic colour only: gain, loss, caution and an action or selection accent.
Every chart is drawn to one shared scale per row type, so rows compare.
Both light and dark themes, defined as tokens; dark is a separate palette, not an inversion.

rules.name: The Meaning-Only Colour Rule
rules.body: Green and red only ever mean gain and loss, and ochre only ever means caution. Never use them as decoration or for a category.

rules.name: The Two Bases Rule
rules.body: Independent-valuation figures and provider-aggregate figures never share a sort, and every place they appear (column header, card tag or basis line) names which one it is.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Any column, pill or stat that holds digits uses tabular numerals (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums).

rules.name: The No-Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: No small uppercase label sits above a heading. Headings carry their own weight, and context goes in a chip beside the heading or a sentence below it.

rules.name: The Flat-at-Rest Rule
rules.body: Nothing is lifted at rest. If an element needs separation, give it a rule line or a tone step.

dos: Do label every number's basis (our model, named analysts or the provider aggregate) in its header, tag or basis line.
Do keep negative returns, unresearched names and unverified caps visible, with a chip for their status.
Do draw every row of a given chart type on one shared scale.
Do style the browser's own details: text selection in cobalt wash, accent-color in cobalt, scrollbars in rule-line colour, and a 2px cobalt focus ring.
Do switch tables to stacked lists below 720px rather than letting the page scroll sideways.
donts: Don't merge independent and provider-aggregate upside into one unlabelled sort.
Don't use green, red or ochre for decoration.
Don't add small uppercase labels above headings, numbered section markers, or Unicode or emoji glyphs as icons. Use drawn SVG.
Don't lift elements with shadows at rest.
Don't put display type in labels, buttons or table data.
